text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan has been training late into the evenings in preparation for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On one such occasion, she encounters Ines Fujin, who is also still practicing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines vows to grab Ryan's attention, as Ryan is focused solely on beating Mejiro McQueen in their next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, Mejiro Ryan begins to feel anxious about competing against her friend.
